name: Restore three drawables

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
## Restore three drawables

Experiment 17 cut the Metal drawables to two and its A/B read effects-cards +31% CPU, which was put down to that scenario's bimodal timing. A final comparison against the original baseline (alternating the baseline and current binaries) still showed effects-cards +37% and dashboard-one-panel +14%, so the drawable count was switched inside one binary with an environment variable.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Same binary, drawables 2 vs 3, alternating, 3 runs each, effects-cards and dashboard-one-panel.

measurements.delta: about -30% with three (two of three runs; the first is the slow mode)
two drawables stall on the previous frame

reportMarkdown:
## Restore three drawables Finished

Passed: true (the revert wins). With two drawables a frame waits for the one before it to be presented, so the main thread runs 1.5x as long on the GPU-heavy `effects-cards` and the frame interval stretches to 4.6-8 ms; three drawables cost 16 MB at this window size. CPU time is the better of the two for the application, so experiment 17's saving is given back and the finding kept as a rule: three drawables, re-measure effects-cards before lowering it.

Attempt Count: 1.
